scientific_integrity: Exact finite classification from all 192 maximal geodesic masks, all 65536 vertex subsets, component searches in four full budget graphs, and 780 shortest optimum-pair distances. Two differently constructed Python checkers replay successfully. This establishes no infinite-dimensional theorem and is not an independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the sixteen-vertex binary cube and single-vertex token addition/removal with budget six through nine. The minimum count of forty and its two known types are credited as prior art. Priority beyond inspected public literature is provisional.
title: A two-spare optimum-mobility threshold and a three-spare full-connectivity threshold for geodesic transversals of the four-cube
